timeline.text: Welcome to Feeling Like You're Behind in Life. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel like I am behind in life.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep measuring myself against a timeline.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am comparing my life to everyone else's milestones.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice what I have not accomplished yet.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels the pressure of this comparison.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to feel like I am where I should be.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me believes I am running out of time.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this feeling is heavy.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This timeline is weighing on me.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can question where this timeline even came from.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: There is no single right pace for a life.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can notice my own progress instead of theirs.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to measure myself against a highlight reel.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften around this pressure.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to be exactly where I am.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: There is still time for whatever matters to me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can release the idea that I am late.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this timeline loosen its grip.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust my own pace.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My life is not a race against anyone else's.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can build a life that fits me, not a schedule.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can celebrate my own progress.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel at ease with where I am.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am exactly on time for my own life.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am allowed to take the time I need.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can move forward without rushing.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to release this comparison.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
